verdict.rationale: Evidence covers gaming/creative performance, cache size, and platform longevity, but contains no published memory bandwidth figures or maximum supported RAM capacity that would let a buyer judge feasibility of running a 70B-class quantized model. The Ryzen AI Software mention targets NPU-equipped mobile/AI PCs, not this desktop socket AM5 part's memory subsystem. Missing for 10: published memory bandwidth (GB/s), max supported DRAM capacity/channels, and any local-LLM inference benchmark or capacity claim tied to this specific chip.
